verdict.rationale: The UCP CLI and MCP servers expose structured, scriptable commands (search catalog, build carts, create checkout, track orders) with token-based auth and a reusable local profile, all suited to non-interactive/CI use (shopify-ucp-docs-1, shopify-ucp-supp-ucp-journey, shopify-ucp-docs-36). However, checkout completion frequently requires buyer escalation via a browser continue_url (shopify-ucp-supp-buyer-handoff), which breaks fully headless automation for purchase flows, and there is no explicit CI/pipeline documentation or automated-testing guidance. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage examples, confirmation that complete_checkout can run without human-in-the-loop escalation in typical cases, and independent evidence of automated pipeline use.
